questions.explanation: Clouds are made of millions of tiny water droplets that float in the sky.
Rain falls from clouds when water droplets get too heavy.

questions.questionText: Can water change from liquid to gas?
questions.explanation: Yes! Water can change from liquid to gas (water vapor) through evaporation.

questions.questionText: Draw what you think the water cycle looks like:
questions.correctAnswer: Any drawing showing water movement (baseline assessment)
questions.explanation: This helps us see what you already know about the water cycle!
The sun's heat causes water to evaporate and turn into water vapor.
